characters.pronunciationInstruction: Pronounce ARI as อาริ (Ah-ree), two syllables.

continuityRules.names: System/display names remain C-SHARP and ARI. Spoken dialogue should use ซีชาร์ป and อาริ for reliable Thai TTS.
continuityRules.noNameplates: Never render names, usernames, labels, chat bubbles, health bars, overhead UI, subtitles, captions, or text above either child's head. Do not render C-SHARP or ARI as visible text inside the generated scene unless a story prop explicitly requires unrelated text.
continuityRules.dialogue: Use one speaking character per scene. Alternate speaking scenes between C-SHARP and ARI when practical. The non-speaking brother stays silent with a closed mouth or natural reaction. Keep each line short enough for one 8-second scene.
continuityRules.visualIdentity: Both brothers are stylized East Asian boys with fair/light skin and dark-brown hair. C-SHARP is consistently taller/older; ARI is consistently shorter/younger. Keep the same outfits, hair, face design, skin tone, props and proportions across all 10 EP.
continuityRules.previousSceneReference: For scene 2 onward, when PRO V6.8 allows scene references, use the immediately previous generated scene image as the primary continuity reference when the location/time/action continues. Preserve faces, skin tone, outfits, props, relative height, screen direction, obstacle state and lighting. Do not use previous-scene reference when the story intentionally jumps to a clearly different location or time unless needed only for character identity.
continuityRules.dialoguePronunciation: Pronounce ARI as อาริ (Ah-ree), two syllables; pronounce C-SHARP as ซีชาร์ป in spoken Thai dialogue.
